title: SvgG
responsibility: Renders the native g element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgG.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte Snippet rendered inside the g element only when it is truthy; when it is omitted, this component renders no child content. It matters when the caller needs nested content inside the group, and the component adds no validation, so whatever the snippet renders passes through unchanged.

outputs.name: SvgG
outputs.description: The rendered native g element, always tagged g in the SVG namespace set by svelte:options, with every prop except children forwarded as an attribute and the children snippet rendered inside it when provided. The component adds no wrapper element, so callers' attributes and content land directly on this g element.
